convention.in_place: every clip keeps the root still; the game moves the body. Loops: first frame == last frame.
convention.sockets_axis: each socket's local +Z points out of it (muzzle: along the bore; eye/visor: out of the face)

skeleton.naming: Quaternius universal rig (root pelvis spine_01..03 neck_01 Head clavicle/upperarm/lowerarm/hand _l/_r, thigh/calf/foot/ball _l/_r, fingers)

Aim.source: authored on UAL1 Pistol_Idle_Loop (stance, breath): rifle shouldered, aim drifts under half a degree
Aim.note: rifle shouldered and level on +Z, the sights drift under half a degree; loops. Fire starts and ends on Aim t=0

Death.source: UAL1 Death01: falls on his back, rifle across his chest + rifle held in both hands
Death.note: UAL1 Death01: falls on his back; the rifle comes across his chest as he goes down and ends lying on it, both hands on. Ends resting on his back pack about 1 cm off the street

Fire.source: authored from Aim t=0: three rounds, recoil kicks the muzzle up ~6.5 deg and the stock back into the shoulder; ends on Aim t=0
Fire.note: three-round burst: muzzle flash / projectile at each 'shots' time; each round kicks the muzzle ~6.5 deg up and the stock back 2.8 cm, settles on Aim t=0 by 0.6 s

Hit.source: UAL1 Hit_Chest + rifle held in both hands
Hit.note: UAL1 Hit_Chest with the rifle held in both hands

Idle.source: UAL1 Pistol_Idle_Loop (body) + rifle at low ready, both hands solved on
Idle.note: rifle at low ready (muzzle down and across the body), both hands on it; breath from Pistol_Idle_Loop; loops

Melee.source: authored: cocks the rifle back, lunges on the left foot and swings the stock round into the face at head height, recovers to Idle t=0
Melee.note: rifle-butt stroke: winds back (0-0.23 s), lunges on the left foot and swings the stock round into the face at 1.47 m, centre front, 0.72 m ahead of the root at 'contact'; recovers to Idle t=0 by 1.13 s. contact_socket weapon_butt

Run.source: UAL1 Jog_Fwd_Loop (legs, hips) + rifle carried at port
Run.speed_note: natural ground speed (median slide of the planted foot); play at stride/speed_mps for planted feet
Run.note: UAL1 Jog_Fwd_Loop legs, rifle carried across the chest (port); dropped 3.4 cm so the feet land

Stagger.source: UAL2 Idle_Shield_Break + rifle held in both hands
Stagger.note: UAL2 Idle_Shield_Break with the rifle held in both hands

StrafeL.source: authored: side shuffle with a short float between steps, rifle shouldered and on the target
StrafeL.note: moves toward his own left (+X when facing +Z): quick side shuffle, rifle shouldered on the target. Authored for the speed in speed_mps

StrafeR.source: authored: side shuffle with a short float between steps, rifle shouldered and on the target
StrafeR.note: mirror of StrafeL toward his right (-X when facing +Z)

Walk.source: UAL1 Walk_Loop (legs, hips) + rifle at low ready
Walk.speed_note: natural ground speed (median slide of the planted foot); play at stride/speed_mps for planted feet
Walk.note: UAL1 Walk_Loop legs, rifle at low ready, head held on the target

muzzle.purpose: shot origin at the muzzle brake's crown, child of hand_r; local +Z points out of the barrel (verified in three.js)

sight.purpose: the holographic sight's front lens (glows pink), child of hand_r; +Z along the bore

weapon_butt.purpose: centre of the butt plate, child of hand_r: Melee's contact point (the stock is what hits)

weapon_grip.purpose: centre of the pistol grip inside the right fist, child of hand_r

weapon_tip.purpose: the rifle's front, 1.6 cm behind the crown, child of hand_r: the catch clash point

visor.purpose: centre of the pink slit on the helmet face, child of Head; +Z out of the face

materials.enforcer_armor_mat: baked 2048 atlas (JPEG): baseColor, ORM (R occlusion, G roughness, B metalness), tangent normal. Plates are satin black polymer (roughness ~0.42) and graphite (~0.35) with worn edges, a dark twill suit, rubber gloves and soles, gunmetal rifle parts, glossy black visor glass
materials.enforcer_visor: untextured emissive hot pink (linear 1.0, 0.09, 0.45), KHR_materials_emissive_strength 5: the visor slit, the rifle sight's lenses, a short light on each pauldron and one on the back pack. city-enemies.js drives its emissive colour/intensity as the tell; all of them flash together

summary: Corp-sec trooper: matte black and graphite plates over a dark suit, closed helmet with a hot pink visor slit, heavy shoulders, compact bullpup in the right hand. One skinned mesh: baked atlas + one emissive glow material.
